articles.title: US-Saudi nuclear deal signed
articles.body_text: Saudi Arabia and the United States signed a civil nuclear cooperation agreement in Riyadh on Thursday, according to officials from both governments. The agreement allows the transfer of non-military nuclear technology and rules out any uranium enrichment, the officials said, speaking after a signing ceremony in the Saudi capital attended by representatives of several partner nations and energy agencies.

claims.text: The United States and Saudi Arabia signed a civil nuclear cooperation agreement on Thursday.
The deal excludes uranium enrichment and allows only non-military nuclear technology.

articles.body_text: The agreement is contingent on Saudi Arabia joining the Abraham Accords and recognising Israel, the US president wrote on social media, throwing the so-called breakthrough into doubt a day after it was announced.
